newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: Zimbabwe shares end firm in active trade.
newsitem.headline: Zimbabwe shares end firm in active trade.

text.p: Zimbabwe industrial shares finished Tuesday firmer in active trade, egged on by continued positive fundamentals on the bourse.
"I think the underlying fundamentals are still strong and good company results are expected in a number of the counters," said one broker.
"We saw more gains than losses today," he said.
The 57-counter industrial index added 109.59 points to close at 10,005.68, largely on the back of a 50-cent gain in blue chip conglomerate Delta to 1,500.
Zimpapers at 2,800, FMB at 5,800 and Edgars at 5,000 were all 100 cents firmer.
The day's losers included Hunyani Warrants which shed 15 cents to 160 while Cairns was 100 cents weaker at 2,000.
Minings were slightly more active than of late, with the seven-share index putting on 1.09 points to 887.93, prompted up by a 25 cent gain to 675 in nickel producer Bindura.
